description:
[Knowledge base] List the company's knowledge base documents, optionally for one store, with the interviews each is limited to. Pass knowledge_base_id to read one document's limit.

Paginated list of your company's knowledge base documents (uploaded files, URLs and written documents), each with the interviews it is limited to. Pass `knowledge_base_id` to read one document's limit. Capped at 1000 records per page.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

knowledge_base_id.description: Read this one document. Answers 404 if your token cannot see it, including when it is another company's. `merchant_id` and `offset` are ignored.

knowledge_base_store_id.description: Only the documents of this knowledge base store. Omit for every store of the company.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000).

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

name: list_knowledge_base_documents

data.description: The documents for this page with the interview limit of each, newest first.

interview_ids.description: The interviews this document is limited to. Present only when `limit_to_interviews` is true; an empty list means no interview can use it.

knowledge_base_store_id.description: The knowledge base store the document belongs to.

limit_to_interviews.description: True when the document is limited to the interviews in `interview_ids`. False when every interview on the knowledge base can use it.

merchant_id.description: The company that owns the document.

processing_status.description: Parsing progress of a file or URL. Written documents have none.

has_more.description: True when more records exist beyond this page (offset + returned < total).

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: List knowledge base documents
